title: The first law
target: Use a consistent sign convention in an energy balance.
criteria: State whether heat enters or leaves.
Distinguish work done by the system from work done on it.
Apply ΔU=Q-W with the stated signs.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: Use ΔU = Q − W_by. A system receives 65 J as heat. What sign and value should Q have?
cpa.guide: Heat entering is positive under the stated convention.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Under the same convention, a system releases 28 J as heat. What is Q?
cpa.guide: Heat leaving the chosen system gives negative Q.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A gas expands and does 45 J of work on its surroundings. In ΔU = Q − W_by, what is W_by?
cpa.guide: Work done by the system is positive in this convention.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A piston compresses a gas and does 35 J of work on it. What is W_by for the gas?
cpa.guide: Work on the gas means negative work by the gas.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A gas absorbs 95 J as heat and does 30 J of work. What is ΔU?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A system loses 20 J as heat while the surroundings do 70 J of work on it. What is ΔU?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
